label: До
description: The preposition до ('up to/until/before') + genitive: spatial and temporal limits, plus the от…до pairing.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Spatial limit. 1. 'До угла' marks the endpoint of the movement. 2. The genitive case follows до. 3. The imperative иди names reaching that limit.
Strategic focus: Spatial distance. 1. 'До города' sets the far endpoint. 2. The genitive case follows до. 3. Далеко measures the span to that limit.
Strategic focus: Spatial limit. 1. 'До двери' marks the endpoint reached. 2. The genitive case follows до. 3. The verb проводил names accompanying to that limit.
Strategic focus: Spatial limit. 1. 'До конца' names the far endpoint. 2. The genitive case follows до, and улицы is also genitive. 3. The chain marks how far.
Strategic focus: Temporal limit. 1. 'До вечера' bounds the time until evening. 2. The genitive case follows до. 3. A clean until-when line.
Strategic focus: Temporal limit. 1. 'До завтра' bounds the time until tomorrow. 2. The genitive form follows до. 3. It postpones the matter.
Strategic focus: Temporal limit. 1. 'До обеда' bounds the time until lunch. 2. The genitive case follows до. 3. It frames the morning span.

missions.phrase: Нужно закончить проект до конца недели.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Temporal limit. 1. 'До конца' bounds the time at week's end. 2. The genitive case follows до, and недели is also genitive. 3. A deadline span.

missions.phrase: Этот дом построили ещё до войны.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: 'Before' sense. 1. 'До войны' places the event before the war. 2. The genitive case follows до. 3. Here до means prior to, not until.

missions.phrase: Я волнуюсь до встречи с ним.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: 'Before' sense. 1. 'До встречи' marks the time before the meeting. 2. The genitive case follows до. 3. Here до means prior to that event.
Strategic focus: Farewell. 1. 'До свидания' is the standard goodbye. 2. The genitive case follows до. 3. Literally 'until the next seeing'.
Strategic focus: Farewell. 1. 'До скорого' is a casual 'see you soon'. 2. The genitive form follows до. 3. The adjective stands in for a noun.

missions.phrase: От дома до работы всего час.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: От…до pairing. 1. 'От дома' gives the start, 'до работы' the end. 2. Both prepositions take the genitive case. 3. The pair frames the full span.
Strategic focus: Temporal limit. 1. 'До утра' bounds the time until morning. 2. The genitive case follows до; самого agrees with утра. 3. Самого intensifies the limit.

missions.phrase: Спасибо за вечер, до новых встреч.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Farewell. 1. 'До новых встреч' is a warm 'until we meet again'. 2. The genitive plural follows до. 3. Новых agrees with встреч.
